association: same page, numeric run at regular right-aligned x; nearby monospace non-URL line at matching y; region may have indentation within 12 em

basis.consecutive_y_min_em: reject same-baseline fragments; half em is a conservative different-line floor
basis.font: reuse the family-name monospace signal documented in Part 1, not a document identifier
basis.geometry: dimensionless conservative allowances for line leading, right-aligned integers, font ascent differences and indentation; design choices, not calibrated accuracy or fitted annotation thresholds
basis.gutter: four sequential integers and >=75% local mono association reject isolated page numbers and short numbered prose; regular step tolerance permits rounding
basis.mono_fraction: all words monospace prevents prose containing one monospace URL being classified as code
basis.preservation: URLs excluded from mono seeds; no ID/page/source-specific constants; glyphs never removed; pure gutter only excluded like page numbers
basis.two_lines: minimal region evidence required by L3-11; single line never enough without associated gutter

block_decision: any line in a >=2-line monospace region or associated gutter marks that block text/code_text; pure numeric blocks whose every word belongs to a confirmed gutter become non-citable; mixed gutter/diff/code blocks retain all characters and +/- markers
name: M3-consecutive-monospace-and-sequential-gutter-v1
policy: existing text role plus existing Block.code_text flag; no enum/schema change; no text deletion; only wholly numeric gutter blocks non-citable
unknown: all words need font_face, positive size and bbox; missing data unchanged/unknown, never negative evidence
